overview_description.description: GloPos is the developer of GlobalMPS, an accurate Cell-ID based, software-only positioning technology. GlobalMPS enables location applications to show the exact indoor position of the mobile phones. It’s self-learning algorithms calculate an accurate position even in places where no GPS is available (i.e. in shopping malls, subways, underground parking, airports, sports arenas, exhibition centers). The technology works wherever GSM network coverage is available. GlobalMPS can also be used for making wi-fi positioning more accurate.
